verdict.rationale: The evidence documents multi-currency accounts in 20+ currencies and accounting-software sync. Nothing shows running multiple legal entities in one account, consolidated cross-entity reporting, or per-entity books. Multi-currency balances alone are an adjacent feature and do not deliver the multi-entity consolidation this story centers on.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run multiple legal entities and currencies in one account with consolidated reporting and per-entity books
